caption_candidates.text: Fig. 1 Classification of the bone defects caused by all-suture anchors at 1-year follow-up. The diagram shows the relative incidence for each type, including the 95% confidence interval. The numbers overlaid on the graph represent the absolute numbers

Fig. 2 Frequency histogram of the volumes of the bone defects caused by all-suture anchors at 1-year follow-up. No anchor caused a bone defect larger than 100 mm $ ^{3} $. The 16 anchors in which the bone filled completely the drill tunnel can be clearly seen at the left of the histogram

Fig. 3 Schematic representation of a sagittal view of a right glenoid with the clock lines dividing the different glenoid edge zones.
